title: Ionis Employees Give Back During First-Ever “Days of Impact”
summary: This November, Ionis employees from coast to coast stepped away from labs and workspaces to support their local communities during the first-ever “Days of Impact”.
body_markdown:
This November, Ionis employees from coast to coast stepped away from labs and workspaces to support their local communities during the first-ever “Days of Impact”. The company-wide volunteer week brought 250+ employees together through meaningful service in the communities where they live and work.


**Together, employees:**


- Contributed 400+ volunteer hours,
- Supported 21 non-profits,
- Packed 2,315 meals and
- Built 624 care and STEM kits, alongside many other success


> Days of Impact brings our volunteerism commitment to life at our largest scale to date. This dedicated week of service reflects the care and collaboration that define our culture at Ionis, and by coming together across the country to support our communities, we are building stronger connections with our neighbors and each other.


Katharine Brewer Director, Corporate Responsibility


Every day, Ionis employees work to improve the lives of people living with serious diseases. Days of Impact offered a new way to put that purpose into action.
